title: Topic mining feeds for facts, history, science and trends
description: Feeds that surface dated, citable topics for fact-led shorts: Wikipedia featured feeds and on-this-day data, NASA and APOD, ScienceDaily, Smithsonian and Google Trends. Use them to pick topics, then cite the primary source in the video description.

items.title: English Wikipedia 'On this day' featured feed (Atom)
items.summary: Daily 'On this day' selections from the Main Page; a steady source of dated history topics.
items.notes: The featuredfeed API module comes from the MediaWiki FeaturedFeeds extension (documentation in search results); the same URL pattern was listed for German Wikipedia. The English URL was not fetched.
cautions: Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA: paraphrase facts and cite the underlying sources rather than reading the text verbatim; credit and share-alike apply if you reuse text.

items.title: English Wikipedia featured article feed (Atom)
items.summary: Today's featured article: one well-sourced long article a day.
items.notes: Same FeaturedFeeds API pattern as the on-this-day feed; not fetched.
cautions: Follow the article's references for facts and numbers.

items.title: English Wikipedia picture of the day feed (Atom)
items.licence: Per file (check the file page on Wikimedia Commons)
items.notes: Same FeaturedFeeds API pattern; a Phabricator task notes POTD feeds carry no licence information, so open each file page.
cautions: Licence and credit are per image and not included in the feed.

items.title: Wikimedia REST 'onthisday' endpoint (example: events on 15 January)
items.summary: JSON list of events for a month/day (/feed/onthisday/{type}/{mm}/{dd}); easier to parse than the Atom feed.
items.notes: Endpoint shape from Wikimedia Phabricator tickets in search results; the service was being moved from RESTBase to wikifeeds, so check the current path.
cautions: Send a descriptive User-Agent with contact details, as Wikimedia's API etiquette asks.

items.title: NASA RSS feeds index
items.summary: NASA's official list of feeds, including Image of the Day and news releases.
items.licence: NASA media generally not copyrighted; follow NASA media usage guidelines and per-item credits
items.notes: Official page returned in search results.

items.title: NASA Image of the Day feed
items.licence: NASA media generally not copyrighted; check credits (some images are from partners)
items.notes: URL given by a feed directory; the official index lists an Image of the Day feed.
cautions: Images credited to non-NASA partners can carry other rights; NASA logos and insignia are restricted.

items.title: NASA news releases feed
items.licence: Public domain (US Government work) unless noted
items.notes: A feed directory reports the old breaking-news feed redirects here.

items.title: NASA all-content feed
items.licence: Public domain (US Government work) unless noted
items.notes: URL from a feed directory in search results.

items.title: Astronomy Picture of the Day RSS
items.summary: Daily astronomy image with an expert explanation, since 1995.
items.licence: Per image: many APOD images are copyrighted by their photographers
items.notes: Listed by Harvard's TagTeam feed hub (last change recorded 19 December 2025); older APOD pages give an antwrp.gsfc.nasa.gov address for the same feed.
cautions: APOD images are often not NASA's: check the credit line and get permission for copyrighted images.

items.title: Google Trends: trending now (US) RSS
items.summary: Currently trending US searches with approximate traffic and related news links; change geo= for other countries.
items.notes: Used by several third-party tools in search results; Google offers no official API for this list and may change it without notice.
cautions: Trends show attention, not facts: research each topic from primary sources before scripting.

items.title: ScienceDaily: all news
items.summary: All ScienceDaily research news summaries, updated as often as hourly.
items.licence: Custom: headlines may be integrated with attribution and a link; no full-text reposting
items.notes: Listed on ScienceDaily's own newsfeeds page in search results.
cautions: Summaries are press releases: read the linked paper before using any number.

items.title: Smithsonian Magazine: latest articles
items.summary: Latest Smithsonian Magazine articles on history, science and culture.
items.notes: Listed by a feed directory in search results.

items.title: Smithsonian Magazine: Smart News
items.summary: Short daily science and history news items; well suited to 60-second fact topics.
items.notes: Listed by a feed directory in search results.

items.title: Smithsonian Magazine: Science & Nature
items.notes: Listed by a feed directory in search results.

items.notes: Listed by a feed directory in search results.
